q.line: We need a record of our failures
stanza: So Michael, please keep the tape rolling
We need a record of our failures
Yes, we must document our love
I've sat too long in my silence
Have grown too old in my pain
To shed this skin, be born again

partner.line: Have grown too old in my pain

q.line: Don't confront me with my failures
stanza: Things are bound to be improving
These days I'll sit on cornerstones
And count the time in quarter tones to ten
Don't confront me with my failures
